meta.description: A tappable content card — slotted leading icon, a heading with tag and badge, two label-and-description rows, and a slotted trailing chevron.

verdict.title: Keep — all findings resolved
verdict.text: Rebuilt on node 5412:31504 in the 2026 Working File as Status = Default | Skeleton × State = Default | Disabled × IconSize = XL | LG | MD | SM | XS | XXS over 18 variants. The naming pass is complete: all three properties PascalCase per §1 with Title Case values per §5, the ⤷ glyph and the # sigil both gone, text layers on the §3 vocabulary and §7 hierarchy, frames PascalCase with the two meaningless offset frames replaced by PreambleContainer and IconContainer, and both slots kebab-cased with the -Slot suffix the rest of the system uses. Splitting Skeleton onto its own Status axis matches §6 and Upload File. The paired TextContainer rows are confirmed intentional peers, the state coverage is confirmed complete at 18 variants, and all six icon sizes are confirmed in use. All four DS Health traits pass; the only item still open is Code Connect, blocked until the native library exists.

overview.inContextNote: Generic Card stacks vertically into a scrolling list — product catalogs, service menus, transaction history detail screens. Icon size tightens as the density of the list increases.

traits.name: Reusable
traits.note: A generic tappable content card — the two slots and the label/description rows carry product, transaction or service content without the component knowing which.

traits.name: Self-contained
traits.note: Owns its container, spacing and typography, and composes shared Badge and Chevron Right instances rather than redrawing them.

traits.name: Consistent
traits.note: Status, State and IconSize are all PascalCase per §1 with Title Case values per §5 on the standard sizing vocabulary; Skeleton sits on Status rather than competing with interaction on State, per §6; text layers follow the §3 vocabulary and the §7 hierarchy; frames are PascalCase throughout, including the skeleton variants; and both slots are kebab-cased with the -Slot suffix used across the system.

traits.name: Composable
traits.note: leadingIcon and trailingIcon are both real Figma Slots, so the artwork and the trailing affordance are consumer-supplied, and the badges are shared instances.

behavior.notes: Normal row — all content visible, chevron shown when hasChevron.
Loading pattern — gray rounded placeholders where each content slot would render. Kudos for shipping this as a first-class variant.
Tappable row (has chevron) — needs a pressed state with background tint for tap feedback.
For temporarily-unavailable services (e.g. maintenance). Typically dimmed label + muted icon.

resolved.headline: Leading icon is a real Figma Slot.
resolved.body: v2.0: Rebuilt on node 5412:31504 in the 2026 Working File. leadingIcon is a genuine SLOT holding a Placeholder instance as its swap target, replacing the hardcoded circle the previous assessment flagged. A consumer supplies their own artwork without detaching, and native handoff has a real content slot to bind. (C1 · Slot)

resolved.headline: Chevron is a vector instance in a slot.
resolved.body: v2.0: The raster chevron is gone. trailingIcon is a SLOT carrying a Chevron Right instance from the shared icon library, so it recolours from tokens and stays crisp at any density — and because it is slotted, a card that needs a different trailing affordance can swap it. (C6 · Asset)

resolved.headline: iconSize values moved from numeric to semantic.
resolved.body: v2.0: The six numeric values are replaced by a t-shirt scale — xl | l | m | s | xs | xxs — which is the naming half of the previous recommendation. The count is unchanged at six, and whether all six earn their place is tracked separately below. (C2 · Rename)

resolved.headline: Disabled state added.
resolved.body: v2.0: state=disabled ships across all six icon sizes, closing half of the missing-states finding. Pressed is still absent and is tracked below. (C5)

resolved.headline: skeleton moved onto its own Status axis.
resolved.body: v2.1: The schema is now Status = Default | Skeleton × State = Default | Disabled × iconSize, matching the §6 rule and the shape Upload File uses. A skeleton is the system reporting that content has not arrived; disabled is how the user may interact with it. Separating them means the two no longer compete for one axis. (C2 · Property)

resolved.headline: State and Status PascalCase, all values Title Case.
resolved.body: v2.1: Default, Disabled, Skeleton per §5, and the icon scale is now XL | LG | MD | SM | XS | XXS — aligned to the standard sizing vocabulary rather than the single-letter l | m | s it used before. (C2 · Rename)

resolved.headline: The ⤷ glyph is gone and slots are kebab-cased.
resolved.body: v2.1: ⤷ icon, ⤷ leadingIcon and ⤷ trailingIcon are now MediaContainer, Leading-Icon and Trailing-Icon — the literal arrow character is removed from every layer, and both slots follow §4 kebab-case, so nothing in the tree blocks a generated identifier. (C1 · Rename)

resolved.headline: Legacy sigil dropped and frames moved to PascalCase.
resolved.body: v2.1: #tag → Preamble, #name → Title, #label → Label, #description → Description, putting the text layers on the §3 vocabulary and the §7 hierarchy. The frames follow: container → ContentRow, content-block → ContentBlock, text-container → TextContainer, badge-container → BadgeContainer. Both frames named offset are gone, replaced by PreambleContainer and IconContainer, which say what they hold. (C1 · Rename)

resolved.headline: Skeleton variants brought onto the shared vocabulary.
resolved.body: v2.1: icon-container — with its trailing space — is now MediaContainer, content-block is ContentBlock, and the offset frame standing in for the chevron is IconContainer, all matching the names their default siblings use. A reviewer no longer needs a second mental model to read a skeleton variant. (C1 · Rename)

resolved.headline: Two TextContainer rows confirmed intentional peers.
resolved.body: v2.2: The Coverage block holds two identically-structured rows by design — each a Label and Description pair, the second carrying a further line item rather than a different kind of content. Sharing a name is correct here: they are peers, not a primary and a secondary, and naming them apart would imply a hierarchy the card does not have. Note for implementation: identically-named siblings are matched by order when Figma swaps variants, so an iconSize change re-matches the two rows positionally. That is reliable while both rows are present and in order, and it is the reason to keep them as a fixed pair rather than making either one optional. Native implementations should model this as a list of two label-value rows rather than as two named properties. (C1 · Docs)

resolved.headline: State coverage confirmed as-is.
resolved.body: v2.2: State = Default | Disabled is the intended coverage — no pressed state, and Status=Skeleton deliberately ships only with State=Default. A skeleton is a placeholder for content that has not arrived, so it cannot meaningfully be disabled, and the 18 built variants are therefore the complete set rather than 18 of a nominal 24. Native implementations should treat Skeleton × Disabled as unreachable and should not expect a pressed treatment from the component. (C5)

resolved.headline: iconSize → IconSize.
resolved.body: v2.3: Verified on the live node — all 18 variants read Status × State × IconSize. Every property in the set is now PascalCase per §1 with Title Case values per §5, closing the property pass. (C2 · Rename)

resolved.headline: Slot suffix aligned to the family convention.
resolved.body: v2.3: Leading-Icon and Trailing-Icon are now Leading-Icon-Slot and Trailing-Icon-Slot — kebab-case per §4 with the -Slot suffix the rest of the system uses on Bottom Sheet, Service Item and Upload File. A consumer can now tell a slot from a frame by its name alone, across every component. (C1 · Rename)

resolved.headline: All six icon sizes confirmed in use.
resolved.body: v2.3: XL | LG | MD | SM | XS | XXS stays at six by owner confirmation — each size appears in a real screen rather than being carried forward from the retired numeric scale. The 18-variant count is therefore the intended size of the set, not an artefact. (C2 · Property)

usageGuidelines.doText: Pick IconSize by list density — XL for a product catalog, XXS for a dense service menu.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t mix icon sizes inside one list.

usageGuidelines.doText: Keep the Title to one line inside the 180 px content block.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t let the title wrap under the tag — shorten it instead.

usageGuidelines.doText: Swap Leading-Icon-Slot for the product or service icon at 1:1.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t ship the Placeholder instance to production.

usageGuidelines.doText: Use Status Skeleton while the list loads.
usageGuidelines.dontText: Don’t pair Skeleton with Disabled — the set does not build it.

scorecard.notes: PascalCase frames and three named slots on 5412:31505. A _space_40 spacer instance sits between ContentBlock and IconContainer — confirm it or replace it with padding.
Status, State and IconSize with Title Case values; no absence-based names.

Title resolves to Primary/Headlines/Block, Preamble to Primary/Label/Small, Label and Description to Secondary/Bold/Caption. Colour variable bindings are not readable with the plugin — confirm in Dev Mode.
Three enums, three slots, two text values and two Badge instances — maps 1:1 onto EBGenericCard.
Default and Disabled confirmed as the intended coverage (v2.2); Skeleton exists at State Default only.
Chevron Right is a vector instance in Trailing-Icon-Slot; Leading-Icon-Slot holds a swappable Placeholder instance; Tag and Badge are Badge instances.

rows.body: Style tab rebuilt from the 18 live variants. Cards follow Status — Default, Skeleton — with State and IconSize as panel controls; colours, text styles and the 148 / 146 heights read off 5412:31505 and 5412:31530. Padding, gap, alignment and colour tokens are not readable with the plugin and stay —.

Code tab regrouped on the Status × State × IconSize schema. Property Mapping is one row per property with the three slots, Usage Snippets and Guidelines added, Scorecard regraded, Variants Inventory moved from the 12 numeric iconSize nodes to the 18 live nodes with a summary and full breakdown.

A spacer instance sits in the layer tree. _space_40 (an instance carrying a Roboto "40" label) separates ContentBlock from IconContainer on 5412:31505. Confirm it is intentional or replace it with auto-layout padding. Filed from the scorecard for the Component Review.

Resolved issues recorded. 14 resolved issues on the Overview tab had no changelog row: Leading icon is a real Figma Slot; Chevron is a vector instance in a slot; iconSize values moved from numeric to semantic; Disabled state added; skeleton moved onto its own Status axis; State and Status PascalCase, all values Title Case; The ⤷ glyph is gone and slots are kebab-cased; Legacy sigil dropped and frames moved to PascalCase; Skeleton variants brought onto the shared vocabulary; Two TextContainer rows confirmed intentional peers; State coverage confirmed as-is; iconSize → IconSize; Slot suffix aligned to the family convention; All six icon sizes confirmed in use.
